scenarios.notes: 276x36 glass bar, top-centre, 28px buttons in three groups (undo/redo | child/sibling/delete | card/more). It is registered as an overlay gate before canvas.show; More opens the node menu at the button's bottom edge (trace canvas-tool-more) without changing the selection.
The existing plus/more hover bar keeps its geometry; only its shadow now comes from design::elevation::PANEL via float_shadow(). Two scripted runs produced the same PNG hash e1edb70d...73f8c44f4.

154x32 zoom bar with four non-overlapping 24px hit zones (-/percent/+/fit) anchored 16px from the bottom-right. Status bar left: save dot + four-state label, node count, selection summary; right: theme name with accent dot. Zoom number left the status bar.

Clicking Add child emits canvas-tool-child and goes through the existing Canvas command path: a new node enters inline editing, the titlebar switches to dirty, and the status area shows 14 topics with the new node selected.

Offscreen runs without an input script now inject PointerMoved(-10000,-10000) before PointerGone. PointerGone alone only clears latest_pos while a real desktop move still lands in interact_pos, so Response::hovered stayed true. After the fix library@1.0 and @2.0 returned to the X14 hashes; only @1.5, whose old baseline itself contained a back-button hover, needed rebaselining.

The selected scenario (MW_SELECT_DEMO=1, ppp 1.5) is the 14th golden. Shell/theme drift stayed inside the status bar and zoom bar; outline, outline-focus, card-slash and outline-compact had zero pixel drift. All 14 scenarios passed twice at tolerance 0 (28/28).

tests: cargo clippy -p mw-shell --all-targets (3 historical export_pdf warnings, 0 new)
cargo golden matrix: 14 scenarios x 2 runs at --tol 0 (28/28 clean)
knownGaps: The hover bar is only reproducible under MW_GOLDEN_INPUT; there is no real-desktop hover capture.
Only More and AddChild toolbar buttons have scripted captures; undo/redo/delete/card share the same dispatch arm and are covered by unit tests.
The narrow-canvas toolbar fallback is covered by geometry tests only; no 640x460 full-window capture yet (rolled into X20).
The unified menu engine (submenus, edge flipping, shortcut column, keyboard navigation) remains X16; More only proves the anchor and the existing node menu.
Zoom-bar percentages are not captured per step; reset/fit are covered by existing Canvas methods and geometry tests.
